title: Back in New York, Kenny Dorham hears Sam at a session
summary: After Bradshaw's death Sam plays sessions at the Paradise Club and Kenny Dorham invites him into the Jazz Prophets.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: And that's how I really learned and from one thing led to another, like I said, from Bradshaw to the Jazz Prophets--that was my first big jazz gig.
Kenny Dorham. Jazz Prophets. OK, when I--after Bradshaw--illness and he died. OK, so I'm back in New York now. And uh, Kenny used to be on--remember them ole--125 Club on 125th Street?
Used to be sessions in there. OK, the Paradise Club on 110th and Eighth Avenue where all the guys used to come -- you could find anybody. You could go in there and hear Bird, Dizzy in a session.

And that's with Big Nick--Nicholas. That was his gig. That's where everybody would come in here. And so I was in a session in there when Kenny Dorham heard me up there playing. And he say "hey, man." He said "I like the--" he said "I like the way, the sound that you get out of the bass, see." Say "I'm fixing to get a band out." Say "you got eyes." I say "shit, yeah, man, you know." So what I--I wasn't really suffering too much because I--like I say I'm living with my father, you know my parents and stuff up there. And uh, I'm doing OK. I don't, you know, I don't have no responsibility or nothing. I ain't married or nothing. So I'm--you know, ....it's not really a scuffle for me.
